name: Lead a Dungeon!: the group leader who defeats a dungeon's final boss earns the weekly Call Board credit
contract: On Darkmoon - Season 10 Wildcard the Call Boards offered the weekly quest Lead a Dungeon! (100078, level 60, 5000 Runes of Ascension): 'Remain the group leader and defeat the final boss of any non-Mythic+ dungeon, then return to the Callboard to claim your reward.' Its objective is one Dungeon Leader Credit (101001). When a dungeon's last encounter falls (Edwin VanCleef, the final encounter of The Deadmines), mod-hero-call-board credits every group leader in reward range; other members get nothing. Turning the quest in pays the 5000 runes.
